issues.detail: The Hebrew text says the sons of Samuel are 'the firstborn וַשְׁנִי (Vashni) and אֲבִיָּה (Abijah)', but the Chinese renders the firstborn as '約珥 (Joel)'. This is a name swap: 'וַשְׁנִי' is not 'Joel' but 'Vashni' (or possibly a textual variant, but the Hebrew as given has Vashni, not Joel). The Chinese adds '約珥' which is not in the Hebrew text provided.
